parsed.explanation: The combined regime pairs universal entry exposure (visa/ passport sex-marker bar, refusal where sex is in doubt, fraud/lifetime-ban consideration, blocked passports stranding travellers) with a legislature-imposed facilities ban the local council cannot repeal, a documented restroom arrest held in a men's ward, December 2024 protest arrests, and patterned federal custody abuse (forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse for trans detainees; conversion-therapy inmate policy). Official threat-framing and majority public support for birth-sex document laws compound severity. Offsetting: no criminalisation of trans identity or sodomy, a gender-identity hate-crime statute, a district discrimination ban, functioning courts granting injunctions, and a July 2026 low-risk listing. Exposures are documented and continuous; relief is partial, so Elevated Risk.

entry_documents.exposure: Feb 2025 ministry barred X and non-birth-sex markers on passports/visas; cable orders refusal where documents cast 'reasonable doubt' on sex and consideration of fraud-based lifetime ineligibility; travellers report passports confiscated/blocked and stranding; airport screening outing documented; eight+ foreign states issued travel advisories.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X-marker passports valid to expiry; policies challenged in national courts; legal-aid FAQ on document rules; no criminal penalty for trans identity itself.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy → refusal or fraud allegation → investigation → possible immigration/federal custody where abuse is documented.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Trans immigration detainees report forced-labour programmes, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse with guards invoking 'wanna be a man'; from 2026 federal corrections mandate conversion-therapy-style policies (hair cutting, hormone removal); a trans woman was held 24h in a men's ward after a restroom arrest; activists arrested Dec 2024.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Several orders blocked or enjoined; national gender-identity hate-crime statute; functioning courts and active litigation; consular/ legal access not documented either way.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry sex-doubt → fraud investigation → federal custody → birth-sex placement and documented abuse.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National legislature attached a facilities ban to this division that the local council cannot repeal; scope, covered buildings and enforcement beyond the Dec 2024 arrests are not sourced; reach to visitors uncertain. Four other state/provinces criminalise certain bathroom use (one trespass arrest, 60-day misdemeanour).
federal_state_facilities.protection: Division has no bathroom ban of its own; GI discrimination outlawed in the capital district; July 2026 assessment lists it among units largely refraining from targeting trans adults; 29 state/provinces plus units have no mapped ban.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National override negates local tolerance; visitor using federal-building facilities or protesting risks the same ban.

care_services.exposure: EO framing minor gender-affirming care as 'mutilation'; DOJ subpoenaed 20+ hospitals for under-19 patient records; Oct 2025 proposed rule barring public-insurance reimbursement for under-18 trans care; youth-care bans in 27 state/provinces; hostile climate around carrying HRT.
care_services.protection: Measures partly enjoined or proposed only; no documented denial of emergency care to trans visitors; adult employment discrimination remains nationally prohibited.
care_services.interaction: A visiting trans minor seeking care enters a federal record-scrutiny and liability environment; guardian could face inquiry.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: EOs direct law enforcement to investigate 'gender ideology' and prosecute teachers aiding social transition; May 2026 counterterrorism strategy targets 'radically pro-transgender' groups; 2025 poll: 66% back birth-sex document listing; official rhetoric hostile; foreign advisories warn trans travellers.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 'Radical gender ideology' is not a reward criterion and strategy says CT powers won't target mere disagreement; national hate-crime statute covers GI; no sodomy law.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile framing raises both outing probability and severity of any police or border encounter.

minors_guardians.exposure: Jan 2025 EO directs criminal investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating a trans minor's social transition; under-19 record subpoenas; proposed under-18 insurance bar; 27-state care bans create a care vacuum for a visiting trans child; carrying a minor's medication invites document scrutiny.
minors_guardians.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; direct reach of school/teacher provisions to short-term visitors not documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Family trip + minor's care need → scrutiny, possible care denial, state inquiry into guardian.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No jurisdiction-specific police-practice or local-custody data; public opinion majority favours restrictive document/athletics laws; orientation bias is 1/7–1/5 of single-bias hate incidents; protest arrests recorded Dec 2024.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National gender-identity hate-crime statute; 23 state/provinces cover GI in bias statutes; district outlaws GI discrimination; July 2026 assessment lists division low-risk (law-based, not conditions-based).
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Thin local record means street and custody outcomes for an outed visitor are uncertain, not proven safe.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Nov 2025 Supreme Court let passport restrictions take effect (relief failed there); national legislature/executive can override local protections at any time; scope of the division's ban, local police practice and local custody conditions not documented — absence is not safety.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Multiple injunctions against EOs; civil-liberties union suit pending; legal-aid FAQ; assessment's own caution that protective reputation is no longer settled.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies work unevenly: courts check some orders while the document regime survives review.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.15-B: no entry bar grounded in 'immoral conduct', no months-long crowding, no accepted police summaries, no credible capital penalty, and habeas/courts demonstrably function (multiple injunctions). Custody abuse here is documented but conditional on detention, not the routine border outcome.

Similar in kind to 0.25-C: birth-sex facility rules plus arrest exposure and slow remedies, but here the facilities ban attaches at one government complex rather than prison-wide housing by birth sex nationwide, and federal hate-crime and discrimination law plus active injunctions give firmer recourse than its annulled-case patchwork.

Close to 0.45-D: durable exposure through mandatory document/registry checks regardless of neighbourhood, administrative rather than custodial typical outcome, slow ombuds-style remedies. This dossier is somewhat worse because a fraud-based lifetime-ineligibility threat and patterned custody abuse sit behind the document check.

Higher than 0.75-C only if entry were trained, respectful, appealable with counsel and compensation routine. Here the cable orders refusal on sex doubt, lifetime ban is raised, and passport policy survived Supreme Court review — materially below that tier.

Far below 0.85-B: no recognition of nonbinary/transgender documents, no specialist border training, and a documented custody-abuse record. Its protections (legal aid, apology after prolonged questioning) have no counterpart shown at this jurisdiction's border.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller faces one continuous state-imposed exposure — entry and document screening where sex-doubt triggers refusal and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility — layered onto a legislature-imposed facilities ban the local council cannot repeal, backed by a documented arrest and by December 2024 protest arrests. If the encounter escalates into custody, the record shows patterned abuse of trans detainees and a conversion-therapy inmate policy, with hostile executive and counterterrorism framing and majority public support for birth-sex documents raising both discovery and severity. Offsetting, and genuinely operative: no criminalisation of identity, a federal hate-crime statute, district anti-discrimination coverage, functioning courts that have enjoined several orders, and pending litigation plus legal-aid guidance. Protections are real but partial and cannot reverse the passport ruling; for families, the minor-care regime and under-19 record scrutiny add exposure absent for adults alone. Net: documented universal exposure with incomplete remedy — Elevated Risk, near its lower bound.
